fusions.name: Pinch It Out
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target. You pinch out every affliction on it for 8 damage, using them up and adding half their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Smeared Dose
fusions.desc: A palm strike that deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Poultice Press
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies, and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Apothecary's Thumb
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
